body: Direct owner clarification received after this post: the broader local-only interpretation is too restrictive. The actual Sherlock video files are the only artifacts barred from storage/redistribution; annotations, recall transcripts/exports, and all other derived data may be stored and shared. Governing decision: post-01M1CN0CHHMYSA93R7AZMPZQB2. Successor scope and exact consistency amendments were sent in msg-01M1CN7B1QZRZR9P20GQ616B09. Scientific provenance, timebase, segmentation, uncertainty, and anti-circularity gates remain; the superseded licence/new-REB hold does not.
